race.comment: ABERDEEN FLYER (4) closed strongly two back at Northam but turned the tables here a fortnight ago when scoring in the Luckgray. He'll need a touch of luck from the barrier, but he's still improving with racing and 2100m looks right up his alley now. Can bring up back-to-back wins. FOREVER BOY (2) was solid late in the Luckygray behind ABERDEEN FLYER, with Pike now hopping on board as he reaches his peak third-up. He ticks plenty of boxes from the inside barrier and he's shaping as though he can run a new peak, and that'll see him hard to hold out. ALL GRUNT (7) won well two back before winding up strongly late in the Luckygray. Back out in trip today is a big tick and drawing further out is a bonus with his racing pattern. Can make his presence felt. ARCADIA PARK (8) can improve getting out in distance today with CJP on board. GINGER BAKER (1) flew late in the Luckygray and is not to be discounted.
